nodes.description: Owner-settable payable marketing address that receives swapped ETH from swapBack and is excluded from fees.
Reentrancy lock flag set by lockTheSwap modifier around swapBack.
Boolean gate that enables automatic swapAndLiquify during transfers.
Boolean flag controlling whether general trading/transfers are permitted.
Mapping keyed by tx.origin storing the last transfer block to enforce one purchase per block during launch.
Maximum allowed tx.gasprice during launch anti-sniper window.
Mapping of reflection balances (_rOwned) updated on every token transfer.
Private _transfer core routine handling limits, delays, fee selection, swapBack trigger and token transfer.
Private swapBack guarded by lockTheSwap: swaps contract tokens for ETH, adds liquidity and forwards remainder to marketingAddress.
Private helper approving and calling the Uniswap router to swap tokens for ETH.
Private helper adding liquidity to the Uniswap pair via addLiquidityETH.
onlyOwner function that drains the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender before trading is active.
onlyOwner setter updating marketingAddress and its fee-exclusion status.
onlyOwner function transferring arbitrary ERC20 tokens held by the contract to an arbitrary recipient.
Private dispatcher selecting the correct reflection transfer variant.
External caller msg.sender used for ownership, authorization and ETH withdrawal destination.
tx.origin used as key for per-block purchase throttling.
block.timestamp supplied as Uniswap router deadline for swaps and liquidity adds.
Low-level call forwarding the entire contract ETH balance to marketingAddress inside swapBack.
Low-level call sending the entire contract ETH balance to msg.sender inside withdrawStuckETH.
Constructor minting the full supply to msg.sender, deploying the Uniswap pair and configuring exclusions.
onlyOwner one-way switch enabling trading, swapAndLiquify and recording tradingActiveBlock.
Mapping marking addresses as AMM pairs, used to classify buys/sells and apply max transaction limits.
Minimum contract token balance required to trigger swapBack.
Private _takeLiquidity crediting liquidity/marketing accumulators and _rOwned for the contract.
Private _getRate computing the reflection rate from current rSupply/tSupply.
Public balanceOf returning tOwned for excluded accounts or reflection-derived balances otherwise.
Division by _liquidityFee in _takeLiquidity can revert or divide by zero when fee state is zero.
amount parameter of _transfer.
from parameter of _transfer.
to parameter of _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance read in _transfer to decide whether swapBack should run.
newAmount parameter of updateMinimumTokensBeforeSwap.
_marketingAddress parameter of setMarketingAddress.
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForETH.
Local tokensForLiquidity computed in swapBack and passed to addLiquidity.
_token parameter of transferForeignToken.
_to parameter of transferForeignToken.
Local success flag capturing the low-level call result in swapBack.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the sender used for the internal _transfer call.
tx.origin is used inside _transfer to enforce the per-block transfer delay, creating a tx.origin dependency.
tx.origin indexes _holderLastTransferTimestamp, allowing one purchase per block keyed on tx.origin.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForETH.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in addLiquidity.
amount parameter flows into transfer, limit checks and token accounting.
from parameter flows into limit checks, fee classification and balance updates.
to parameter flows into limit checks, delay checks and fee classification.
contractTokenBalance local is derived inside _transfer for the swap threshold comparison.
The over-minimum contract balance condition determines whether swapBack is executed.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer path updates _rOwned reflection balances.
_transfer invokes swapBack, which performs external calls before the transfer state changes complete.
swapBack performs a raw ETH call to marketingAddress, an external interaction reachable from token transfers.
swapBack calls swapTokensForETH to convert tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH are available.
The low-level call transfers the contract ETH balance to marketingAddress.
inSwapAndLiquify is set by lockTheSwap to prevent reentrant entry into swapBack.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the swapBack invocation.
tradingActive restricts transfers to fee-excluded accounts before launch.
automatedMarketMakerPairs classifies transfers as buys or sells and applies max-amount limits.
minimumTokensBeforeSwap bounds the contract balance used in swapBack.
withdrawStuckETH performs a raw ETH call to msg.sender.
The full contract ETH balance is sent to msg.sender via the low-level call.
onlyOwner restricts withdrawStuckETH to the owner derived from msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts setMarketingAddress using the _owner == _msgSender check.
onlyOwner restricts transferForeignToken to the owner.
_marketingAddress parameter is validated and assigned to marketingAddress.
setMarketingAddress writes the new marketing address into state.
The supplied marketing address is stored directly into the marketingAddress state variable.
tokenAmount parameter is swapped for ETH through the Uniswap router.
_takeLiquidity divides by _liquidityFee, which may be zero, causing division-by-zero arithmetic failure.
_takeLiquidity credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the computed liquidity reflection amount.
_getRate supplies currentRate used to convert liquidity tokens to reflection amounts.
tokensForLiquidity local is passed as tokenAmount into addLiquidity.
newAmount parameter overwrites minimumTokensBeforeSwap after bounds checks.
Constructor assigns the full reflection supply and ownership to msg.sender.
enableTrading flips tradingActive to true.
enableTrading enables swapAndLiquify by setting swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
The low-level call result is captured in the local success flag.
_token parameter selects the ERC20 contract whose balance is drained.
_to parameter is the recipient of the foreign token transfer.
balanceOf reads are the basis of swapBack token accounting and threshold checks.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer and should be folded into that core function node.
The from parameter is only used by _transfer for limit and fee logic.
The to parameter is only used by _transfer for limit, delay and fee logic.
The contractTokenBalance local determines the swapBack threshold and is absorbed by swapBack.
The _marketingAddress parameter is consumed only by setMarketingAddress.
The tokenAmount parameter is consumed only by swapTokensForETH.
The tokensForLiquidity local is consumed by addLiquidity inside swapBack.
The _token parameter is consumed only by transferForeignToken.
The _to parameter is consumed only by transferForeignToken.
The success local only stores the result of the low-level call in swapBack.
